symptom: PC1 cannot obtain IP address via DHCP
show_outputs: SW1# show vlan brief: Fa0/1 in VLAN 10 active. R1# show ip interface brief: Gi0/0.10 is up/up. R1# show run int gi0/0.10: interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10 | encapsulation dot1Q 10 | ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: Missing DHCP Relay (ip helper-address) on router sub-interface

symptom: PC1 cannot ping Gateway 192.168.10.1
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces Fa0/1 status: Fa0/1 disabled administratively down. SW1# show vlan brief: Fa0/1 in VLAN 10
expected_fault: Switchport Fa0/1 is administratively down (shutdown)

symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1 in VLAN 20
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 trunking allowed 1-10. SW2# show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 trunking allowed 1-10
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is pruned/missing from trunk allowed VLAN list

symptom: R1 and R2 cannot form OSPF adjacency
show_outputs: R1# show ip ospf interface Gi0/0: Area 0, MTU 1500. R2# show ip ospf interface Gi0/0: Area 0, MTU 1400. R1# show ip ospf neighbor: State EXSTART/EXCHANGE
expected_fault: MTU mismatch on OSPF point-to-point link

symptom: PC1 can ping Gateway but cannot reach Web Server 10.0.0.5
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists: Extended IP access list 101 | 10 deny ip any host 10.0.0.5 | 20 permit ip any any
expected_fault: Inbound/Outbound ACL explicitly denying traffic to 10.0.0.5

symptom: PC1 cannot resolve hostname 'server.lab.local'
show_outputs: PC1# ipconfig /all: IPv4 192.168.1.100, Gateway 192.168.1.1, DNS Servers 192.168.1.50. R1# show ip dns view: server 192.168.1.5
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS server IP configured on DHCP scope/client

symptom: Host 192.168.1.50 cannot access Internet through NAT
show_outputs: R1# show run | include nat: ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1 overload. R1# show ip access-list 1: 10 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.15
expected_fault: NAT ACL wildcard mask too small (/28 instead of /24) excluding .50

symptom: Sub-interface Gi0/0.20 cannot route packets
show_outputs: R1# show run int Gi0/0.20: interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20 | ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0. SW1# show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 encapsulation 802.1q
expected_fault: Missing 802.1Q encapsulation command on router sub-interface

symptom: Switchport Fa0/5 instantly turns off when PC connects
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces Fa0/5 status: Fa0/5 err-disabled. SW1# show port-security interface Fa0/5: Port Security Enabled, Violation Mode: Shutdown, Security Violation Count: 1
expected_fault: Port security MAC address violation triggered shutdown

symptom: R1 cannot route packets to 172.16.0.0/16
show_outputs: R1# show ip route: 192.168.1.0/24 directly connected. R1# show run | inc ip route: ip route 172.16.0.0 255.255.0.0 10.0.0.2. R1# show ip int brief: Gi0/1 (10.0.0.1/30) is down/down
expected_fault: Static route next-hop interface is down

symptom: PC1 gets IP 169.254.45.12 (APIPA)
show_outputs: SW1# show vlan brief: Fa0/1 (PC1) in VLAN 10 active. R1# show ip dhcp pool: Pool LAN10 Current index 192.168.10.254, Leased addresses: 253/253
expected_fault: DHCP IP Pool exhaustion

symptom: PC1 and PC2 cannot communicate in VLAN 10 across switches
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces Gi0/1 switchport: Administrative Mode: trunk, Operational Mode: trunk. SW2# show interfaces Gi0/1 switchport: Administrative Mode: static access, Operational Mode: static access
expected_fault: Trunk negotiation failure / Mode mismatch (Dynamic/Access vs Trunk)

symptom: R1 and R2 fail to form EIGRP adjacency
show_outputs: R1# show run | sec router eigrp: router eigrp 100 | network 10.0.0.0. R2# show run | sec router eigrp: router eigrp 200 | network 10.0.0.0
expected_fault: EIGRP Autonomous System (AS) number mismatch

symptom: Native VLAN traffic is leaking / CDP warnings on console
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 Native VLAN: 1. SW2# show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 Native VLAN: 99
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch across 802.1Q trunk link

symptom: PC1 cannot ping PC2 on same subnet
show_outputs: SW1# show mac address-table: Fa0/1 (PC1) MAC aaaa.bbbb.cccc VLAN 10. SW1# show mac address-table: Fa0/2 (PC2) MAC dddd.eeee.ffff VLAN 20
expected_fault: Access switchports configured in different VLANs

symptom: Admin cannot SSH into Switch SW1
show_outputs: SW1# show run | sec line vty: line vty 0 4 | login local | transport input telnet
expected_fault: VTY line transport input configured for Telnet only (SSH disabled)

symptom: R1 cannot ping external DNS 8.8.8.8
show_outputs: R1# show ip route: 0.0.0.0/0 [1/0] via 203.0.113.2. R1# show ip interface brief: Gi0/1 is up/up (203.0.113.1/30). R2# show ip route: Gateway of last resort is not set
expected_fault: ISP router missing reverse route back to R1 public IP block

symptom: PC1 receives duplicate IP address collision warning
show_outputs: PC1# ipconfig: 192.168.1.50. SW1# show arp: 192.168.1.50 MAC 0001.9611.2233. Static Printer is assigned 192.168.1.50. R1# show ip dhcp pool: network 192.168.1.0/24 without excluded-address
expected_fault: DHCP pool missing `ip dhcp excluded-address` for static devices

symptom: OSPF Area 1 routers cannot reach backbone Area 0
show_outputs: R2# show ip ospf: Area 1 and Area 2 active. R2# show ip route ospf: No inter-area routes from Area 0
expected_fault: Discontiguous backbone / Area 1 not directly connected to Area 0 without virtual-link

symptom: Web traffic to server fails intermittently (50% drop)
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces Fa0/1: Fa0/1 is up, line protocol is up | Half-duplex, 100Mb/s. Server# ethtool eth0: Speed: 100Mb/s, Duplex: Full, Late Collisions: 4821
expected_fault: Duplex mismatch (Half Duplex vs Full Duplex) causing collisions

symptom: PC1 cannot ping Gateway 10.1.1.1
show_outputs: PC1# ipconfig: IPv4 10.1.1.50 Subnet 255.255.255.0 Gateway 10.1.1.254. R1# show ip interface brief: Gi0/0 is 10.1.1.1/24
expected_fault: Default Gateway IP misconfigured on client host

symptom: RIPv2 routes are not being advertised across subnets
show_outputs: R1# show run | sec router rip: router rip | version 2 | network 172.16.0.0 | auto-summary. R2# show ip route rip: Empty
expected_fault: Automatic network summarization enabled on classful boundary in RIPv2

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi users can access internal private servers
show_outputs: SW1# show run int Fa0/10 (AP Port): switchport access vlan 10 (Corporate VLAN). SW1# show vlan brief: VLAN 10 Corporate, VLAN 50 Guest
expected_fault: Guest Access Point SSID mapped to internal corporate VLAN instead of isolated guest VLAN

symptom: R1 interface fails to send packets to R2
show_outputs: R1# show interfaces Serial0/0/0: Serial0/0/0 is up, line protocol is down. R1# show controllers Serial0/0/0: DCE cable, clock rate not set
expected_fault: Missing clock rate on serial DCE interface

symptom: Core switch STP loop causing 100% CPU utilization
show_outputs: SW1# show spanning-tree: Spanning tree disabled on VLAN 10. SW2# show spanning-tree: Spanning tree enabled
expected_fault: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) inadvertently disabled on switch

symptom: Inside PC unable to browse HTTP/HTTPS outside
show_outputs: R1# show run int Gi0/0 (LAN): ip address 192.168.1.1. R1# show run int Gi0/1 (WAN): ip address 200.1.1.1 | ip nat outside. R1# show ip nat translations: Empty
expected_fault: Missing `ip nat inside` command on router LAN interface

symptom: HSRP standby router stays in Active state causing IP conflict
show_outputs: R1# show standby brief: Group 1, State Active, Virtual IP 192.168.1.1. R2# show standby brief: Group 2, State Active, Virtual IP 192.168.1.1
expected_fault: HSRP group number mismatch on redundant routers

symptom: Branch router cannot establish IPsec VPN tunnel
show_outputs: Branch# show crypto isakmp sa: MM_NO_STATE. Branch# show crypto isakmp policy: encryption aes, hash sha, group 2, auth pre-share. HQ# show crypto isakmp policy: encryption 3des, hash sha, group 2, auth pre-share
expected_fault: Phase 1 ISAKMP encryption algorithm mismatch (AES vs 3DES)

symptom: PC1 cannot reach internet through IPv6 SLAAC
show_outputs: PC1# ipconfig: IPv6 fe80::1 link-local only. R1# show run int Gi0/0: ipv6 address 2001:db8:acad:1::1/64. R1# show ipv6 interface Gi0/0: ND router advertisements are suppressed
expected_fault: IPv6 unicast-routing disabled globally or ND RA suppressed

symptom: CDP/LLDP cannot detect directly connected neighbor
show_outputs: SW1# show cdp neighbors: Empty. SW1# show run | inc cdp: no cdp run
expected_fault: Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP) globally disabled on switch
